title: ClueWeaver: Reward-Guided Dual-Agent Evidence Reasoning for Compact LLMs on Literary Long Narratives
abstract: arXiv:2608.25531v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Humanities and social science research requires close reading of long narrative materials such as novels, scripts, archives, and case reports, yet many users have limited access to costly proprietary long-context models. Compact, locally deployable language models are a practical alternative, but directly feeding them an entire long context remains costly, hard to inspect, and prone to missing sparse evidence. We present ClueWeaver, an evidence-aware dual-agent framework for long-narrative question answering with compact local models. A Finder identifies passages containing answer-critical clues through retrieval-guided segmentation, while an Interpreter derives the answer from the selected evidence, produces rationales with paragraph-ID citations, and applies an internal self-calibration pass for high-risk questions. Both agents are optimized with reward-guided reinforcement learning: Finder rewards emphasize evidence retention and fait

translated_title: ClueWeaver：面向紧凑型大语言模型在长篇文学叙事中的奖励引导双智能体证据推理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25531v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：人文与社会科学研究需要对小说、剧本、档案和案例报告等长篇叙事材料进行细读，但许多用户难以获取昂贵的专有长上下文模型。紧凑型、可本地部署的语言模型是一种实用的替代方案，但直接将整个长上下文输入这些模型仍然成本高昂、难以检查，且容易遗漏稀疏证据。我们提出了ClueWeaver，一种面向紧凑型本地模型的证据感知双智能体框架，用于长篇叙事问答。一个“查找者”智能体通过检索引导的分段识别包含答案关键线索的段落，而一个“解释者”智能体从所选证据中推导答案，生成带有段落ID引用的推理过程，并对高风险问题应用内部自校准步骤。两个智能体均通过奖励引导的强化学习进行优化：查找者的奖励强调证据保留和忠实性。
tldr: ClueWeaver提出了一种奖励引导的双智能体框架，通过“查找者”与“解释者”的协作，使紧凑型本地模型在长篇文学叙事问答中实现高效、可检查且证据忠实的推理。
en_tdlr: ClueWeaver introduces a reward-guided dual-agent framework that enables compact local models to achieve efficient, inspectable, and evidence-faithful reasoning in long-narrative question answering through the collaboration of a Finder and an Interpreter.
